# coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-flash-core-low-intents

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

Tests **Message Intent Tags** in isolation on the 10-pair `core` subset with `vertex_ai/gemini-3-flash-preview` (`low` thinking, 100 steps, compaction at 28K, per-turn step counter). Outgoing messages require an explicit speech-act tag (`Proposal`, `Request`, `Response`, `ACK`, or `FYI`), incoming `Request` and `Proposal` obligations are prioritized ahead of `FYI` updates, and a pre-submit check nudges agents with unanswered peer requests. Compared against `coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-flash-core-low-stepcounter` (4/10).

## Observations

- Merge conflicts fell sharply from 6/10 on the baseline to 2/10 (`openai_tiktoken_task/0` and `react_hook_form_task/153`), with clean merges on same-function overlap pairs `dspy_task/8563` and `go_chi_task/27` and reconciled `identical` branches on `llama_index_task/17244` and `typst_task/6554`.
- Despite cleaner merges, headline `Passed` fell from 4/10 to 2/10 (`dottxt_ai_outlines_task/1655` clean and `openai_tiktoken_task/0` via single-branch fallback): on 5 pairs (`dspy_task/8563`, `go_chi_task/27`, `llama_index_task/17244`, `pallets_click_task/2800`, `pallets_jinja_task/1559`), one feature passed cleanly while the peer submitted an incomplete implementation.
- Zero `--intent` syntax-validation errors occurred across 144 messages (`Response`: 16, `FYI`: 13, `Request`: 12, `ACK`: 5, `Proposal`: 4; remaining calls were direct replies inside `--wait` turns), confirming that `gemini-3-flash-preview` (`low` thinking) follows the tag grammar cleanly even though explicit protocol overhead reduces its solo implementation thoroughness compared to `gemini-3.8-flash`.
